name: darwin-core
label: Darwin Core (Biodiversity)
description: Biodiversity occurrence data — GBIF global database, natural history collections worldwide

table_notes.dwc_dataset: Provenance record for each contributing dataset (GBIF resource, collection, or survey); every occurrence traces back here.
table_notes.dwc_occurrence: Core fact table: one row per observed or collected organism event, with location, date, counts, and observer metadata.
table_notes.dwc_taxon: Normalised taxonomic reference from kingdom down to specific epithet, with IUCN conservation status and vernacular name translations.
table_notes.dwc_occurrence_taxon: Junction table linking occurrences to one or more taxa; accommodates uncertain or provisional identifications via qualifier.

dwc_dataset.name: id
dwc_dataset.description: Primary key — UUID for the dataset record

dwc_dataset.name: name
dwc_dataset.description: Full title of the dataset as published by the provider

dwc_dataset.name: publisher
dwc_dataset.description: Organisation or institution that published this dataset

dwc_dataset.name: description
dwc_dataset.description: Free-text abstract describing the dataset scope, methods, and coverage

dwc_dataset.name: license
dwc_dataset.description: Data license under which the dataset is released (e.g. CC0, CC-BY 4.0)

dwc_dataset.name: pub_date
dwc_dataset.description: Date the dataset was published or last updated by the provider

dwc_dataset.name: lang_code
dwc_dataset.description: IETF/ISO 639 language code for the primary metadata language (e.g. en, pt-BR)

dwc_occurrence.name: id
dwc_occurrence.description: Internal primary key for this occurrence row

dwc_occurrence.name: occurrence_id
dwc_occurrence.description: Darwin Core occurrenceID — globally unique identifier assigned by the data provider

dwc_occurrence.name: dataset_id
dwc_occurrence.description: References dwc_dataset.id — identifies the source dataset for this occurrence

dwc_occurrence.name: catalog_number
dwc_occurrence.description: Identifier for the physical specimen within the institution’s collection catalogue

dwc_occurrence.name: collection_code
dwc_occurrence.description: Abbreviated code for the collection within the institution (e.g. HERPS, FISHES)

dwc_occurrence.name: institution_code
dwc_occurrence.description: Abbreviated code for the holding institution (e.g. AMNH, MNHN, CSIRO)

dwc_occurrence.name: basis_of_record
dwc_occurrence.description: DwC basisOfRecord: HumanObservation, PreservedSpecimen, LivingSpecimen, MachineObservation, etc.

dwc_occurrence.name: occurrence_status
dwc_occurrence.description: DwC occurrenceStatus: ‘present’ or ‘absent’ at the location and time recorded

dwc_occurrence.name: event_date
dwc_occurrence.description: Date (or start date) of the occurrence event; ISO 8601

dwc_occurrence.name: decimal_latitude
dwc_occurrence.description: WGS84 latitude of the occurrence in decimal degrees

dwc_occurrence.name: decimal_longitude
dwc_occurrence.description: WGS84 longitude of the occurrence in decimal degrees

dwc_occurrence.name: coordinate_uncertainty_m
dwc_occurrence.description: Radius in metres around the given coordinates within which the true location falls

dwc_occurrence.name: country_code
dwc_occurrence.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the occurrence was recorded

dwc_occurrence.name: locality
dwc_occurrence.description: Specific named place or verbal description of the occurrence location

dwc_occurrence.name: individual_count
dwc_occurrence.description: Number of individual organisms counted during the event

dwc_occurrence.name: organism_quantity
dwc_occurrence.description: Measured quantity of organisms when count alone is insufficient (e.g. biomass, % cover)

dwc_occurrence.name: organism_quantity_type
dwc_occurrence.description: Unit or type for organism_quantity (e.g. individuals, grams, % areal cover)

dwc_occurrence.name: recorded_by
dwc_occurrence.description: Name(s) of people who recorded the occurrence; pipe- or semicolon-delimited list

dwc_occurrence.name: identified_by
dwc_occurrence.description: Name(s) of people who provided the taxonomic identification; pipe- or semicolon-delimited

dwc_occurrence.name: habitat
dwc_occurrence.description: Verbal description of the habitat at the occurrence location (e.g. tropical moist forest)

dwc_occurrence.name: established_means
dwc_occurrence.description: DwC establishedMeans: native, introduced, invasive, naturalised, managed, uncertain

dwc_occurrence.name: occurrence_remarks
dwc_occurrence.description: Free-text notes about the occurrence added by the collector or data curator

dwc_taxon.name: taxon_id
dwc_taxon.description: Darwin Core taxonID — globally unique identifier from the source checklist (e.g. GBIF backbone taxon key)

dwc_taxon.name: scientific_name
dwc_taxon.description: Full scientific name including authorship (e.g. Puma concolor (Linnaeus, 1771))

dwc_taxon.name: kingdom
dwc_taxon.description: Highest Linnaean rank: Animalia, Plantae, Fungi, Bacteria, etc.

dwc_taxon.name: phylum
dwc_taxon.description: Linnaean phylum (division in botany) within the kingdom

dwc_taxon.name: class
dwc_taxon.description: Linnaean class within the phylum (e.g. Mammalia, Aves, Insecta)

dwc_taxon.name: order_name
dwc_taxon.description: Linnaean order within the class (named order_name to avoid SQL reserved word conflict)

dwc_taxon.name: family
dwc_taxon.description: Linnaean family within the order (e.g. Felidae, Orchidaceae)

dwc_taxon.name: genus
dwc_taxon.description: Linnaean genus — first part of the binomial scientific name

dwc_taxon.name: specific_epithet
dwc_taxon.description: Species epithet — second part of the binomial (e.g. concolor in Puma concolor)

dwc_taxon.name: taxon_rank
dwc_taxon.description: DwC taxonRank of this record: species, subspecies, genus, family, order, class, phylum, kingdom, variety, etc.

dwc_taxon.name: vernacular_names
dwc_taxon.description: JSONB object mapping ISO 639 language codes to common names (e.g. {"en": "Mountain Lion", "es": "Puma"})

dwc_taxon.name: taxonomic_status
dwc_taxon.description: DwC taxonomicStatus: accepted, synonym, homotypicSynonym, heterotypicSynonym, misapplied, doubtful

dwc_taxon.name: iucn_status
dwc_taxon.description: IUCN Red List category: EX, EW, CR, EN, VU, NT, LC, DD, NE

dwc_occurrence_taxon.name: occurrence_id
dwc_occurrence_taxon.description: References dwc_occurrence.id — the occurrence being identified

dwc_occurrence_taxon.name: taxon_id
dwc_occurrence_taxon.description: References dwc_taxon.id — the taxon assigned to this occurrence

dwc_occurrence_taxon.name: identification_qualifier
dwc_occurrence_taxon.description: DwC identificationQualifier expressing uncertainty, e.g. ‘cf.’, ‘aff.’, ‘?’, ‘sensu lato’

short_description: Biodiversity occurrence data — GBIF global database, natural history collections worldwide
long_description: Darwin Core is the biodiversity informatics standard maintained by TDWG (Taxonomic Databases Working Group) for sharing occurrence records from natural history collections, field surveys, and citizen science projects. The schema covers dataset provenance, specimen/observation occurrence records with taxonomic identification, full Linnaean taxonomy, and IUCN conservation status.
when_to_use: Use for biodiversity databases, natural history collection management systems, conservation planning tools, or citizen science platforms. Darwin Core is the primary format for GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility), iNaturalist, eBird, and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System. Required for data contribution to GBIF and reporting under the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).
